description: Crafted for precision, this pet nail clipper features sharp stainless steel blades that deliver clean, smooth cuts while reducing the risk of nail splitting or crushing. Selected models include a built-in LED light and magnifier to improve visibility of the nail quick, helping you trim with greater confidence and accuracy. An integrated nail file smooths rough edges after clipping, while the nail debris collector helps keep your grooming area clean. Regular nail trimming promotes healthy paws, improves comfort, and helps prevent overgrown nails that can cause pain or injury. Lightweight, durable, and easy to use, the CS Nail Pet Clipper Small is an essential grooming tool for every pet owner.
